linxia.name: 林夏
linxia.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Japanese visual novel character design sheet and canonical identity anchor
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are style-language references only. Extract only general qualities—clean Japanese manga/anime linework, economical flat shapes, restrained cel shading, delicate facial construction, natural youthful expressions. Do not copy either reference character, pose, costume, composition, cat ears, or identifiable design.
Primary request: redesign Lin Xia (林夏), an original adult woman age 22 and radio/electronics enthusiast, for a contemporary Japanese-style romance visual novel.
Subject: slim natural adult proportions; oval face with a subtle pointed chin; warm amber-brown eyes drawn with clean lashes and small restrained highlights; long straight blue-black hair to the lower back, blunt airy bangs and one thin gold star hairpin; calm intelligent demeanor. Everyday outfit: loose indigo utility overshirt with rolled sleeves over a simple cream crew-neck top, high-waisted ankle-length navy skirt, canvas sneakers, small analog wristwatch. No cleavage, no glamour styling.
Layout: one large full-body neutral standing turnaround-style view, one shoulder-up portrait, and four small consistent facial expression studies: neutral, slight smile, focused, quietly embarrassed. All depictions must be unmistakably the exact same person with identical facial geometry, bangs, hair length, eye color, hairpin, and outfit.
Style/medium: clean contemporary Japanese anime production design sheet; thin confident ink lines; mostly flat cel colors; one hard-edged shadow tone; minimal soft rendering; subtle screentone-like texture only; elegant negative space; hand-drawn 2D look.
Color palette: blue-black, muted indigo, warm cream, amber, desaturated coastal colors.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm off-white paper background, no environment.
Constraints: clearly adult age 22; non-sexualized; anatomically natural; no text or labels; no watermark; original design.
Avoid: glossy skin, oily highlights, airbrushed gradients, painterly rendering, 3D render, photorealism, Western superhero/comic anatomy, voluptuous proportions, pin-up pose, ornate dress, excessive accessories, bloom, lens flare.
